name: Cleanup Orphan Images
author: DimitriAus

sections.description:
Cleanup Orphan Images helps maintain a clean WordPress media library by identifying and removing:

  • Unattached Images – Images not used in posts, pages, or widgets
  • Orphan Files – Physical files not registered in the WordPress database

Features

  • Smart detection of unattached and orphan files
  • Safe manual selection before deletion
  • Batch processing with progress tracking
  • Optimized performance with minimal database queries
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cleanup-orphan-images folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to Media > Cleanup Orphan Images
sections.faq:
Is it safe to delete unattached images?

Review the list before deletion. Some themes or plugins may reference images directly by URL.

Can I recover deleted files?

No, deletion is permanent. Back up your site first.
